answer: The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. The mirror of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short. The comet holds work receipts rather than names, so the plume of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
